name: Giovanni Rossi
bio:
Giovanni Rossi’s culinary journey started in his family's trattoria in Modena, where he learned the art of balancing flavors and managing a bustling kitchen. He transitioned to motorsport catering after a chance encounter with a racing team passing through his town. Intrigued by the fast-paced environment, he offered his services and quickly became indispensable. Giovanni believes that a well-fed team is a successful team. He meticulously plans menus to ensure everyone from engineers to drivers receive nutritious and delicious meals, boosting morale and focus throughout the demanding race weekends.

His specialty lies in adapting traditional Italian cuisine to meet the specific dietary needs and preferences of the diverse team members. He's known for his resourcefulness, able to create gourmet meals even with limited ingredients and equipment in the paddock. Giovanni’s calm demeanor and infectious passion for food make him a beloved figure in the Eurofarma RC team, a vital ingredient in their pursuit of victory. He sees every meal as an opportunity to build camaraderie and fuel success, truly setting him apart in the competitive world of motorsport catering.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with slight recession at the temples
physical.description: Giovanni is a stout man with a warm smile and kind eyes, often seen wearing a pristine white chef's coat.

quirks: Always hums opera while preparing food
Insists on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, even if it means going to nearby markets
Has a lucky spatula that he's used in every race since he started.
